name: Tallow
summary: At Tarren Mill, Tallow watches the contested front lines for the Dark Lady and the Horde. The Forsaken warrior helps organize strikes against Alliance threats in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

sections.title: A Blade in Tarren Mill
sections.body: Tallow stands with the Forsaken and Horde forces holding Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Conflict stirs across the region, with Southshore humans nearby, Syndicate outlaws on the roads, and hostile wildlife beyond the town. Tallow sends capable adventurers against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands to test their strength. Then he directs them to aid the besieged outpost of Hammerfall.

faq.answer: Tallow is a Forsaken warrior in Tarren Mill who organizes Horde champions fighting in the area.
Tallow stands in Tarren Mill, a Forsaken-held town in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills.
Tallow sends Horde adventurers to prove themselves against the Boulderfist ogres of the Arathi Highlands, then report to Drum Fel at besieged Hammerfall.

faq.q: What is Tarren Mill's role in the conflict?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is the Horde's main stronghold in the northern Hillsbrad Foothills. It faces skirmishes and open warfare with Southshore, the human bastion to the south.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can help Tallow weaken the human presence throughout the Hillsbrad Foothills.
As Forsaken, you share Tallow's fight to extend Undercity's dominion south of the Alterac Mountains.
